newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends lower after tracking NYK.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends lower after tracking NYK.

text.p: White sugar futures moved lower during the late afternoon as the earlier fully steady price structure was weakened by a sell-off in the New York raws market, which had opened higher.
The sudden trend reversal prompted fairly widespread liquidation in both markets which resulted in London running up a turnover of 4,805 lots.
Near December traded down to $324.00 a tonne from an earlier high of $328.60. Last business at $324.90, down $2.20 from Thursday. Other active months were between $4.40 and $2.30 down.
In physicals the only news was Syria filling its requirement for one 13,000 tonnes cargo each of raw and white sugar.
Paris white sugar closed with December down $3.30 a tonne at $324.70 a tonne.
